title: Enterprise attestation onboarding: evidence-onramp + concierge credit pathway
creator: Liam O'Connor
description:
Goal: design and pilot a low-friction evidence-onramp for enterprise customers that bundles a lightweight self-attestation path with an optional paid 'concierge evidence' credit to accelerate contract close. Hypothesis: by offering a tiered evidence flow (self-declare -> templated evidence -> concierge-prepared attestation) we reduce average time-to-close for mid-market deals by 25% while controlling marginal support costs via paid credits.

Scope: product-level flows in Console and onboarding emails, pricing trigger for concierge credits, a compact CAIQ answer pack for the self-attest tier, audit log hooks for legal, and a Console export for signed attestations. Excludes backend changes for KMS/HSM — those are parallel work.

Success metrics: (1) median security-questionnaire turnaround for pilot cohort drops from 22 days to <= 8 days, (2) 20% of pilot customers choose concierge credits at pilot pricing, (3) legal/sales NPS for onboarding increases by 0.5 points, (4) average support hours per attestation does not increase >15%.

UI/UX approach: provide a 3-step onramp in Console with clear options: Self-attest (free), Template Pack (free, auto-filled CAIQ snippets), Concierge Credit (paid, includes dedicated SE/solutions time + signed attestation). Include an inline pricing card with credit bundles and estimated lead time.

Pricing experiment: initial pilot pricing for concierge credit bundles: 1-credit = 2 hours of SE prep + signed export; bundles sold in 5-credit/10-credit tiers at incremental discount. Track conversion, avg credits per customer, and impact on contract velocity.

Acceptance criteria: product flows wired to billing test plan, self-attest CAIQ pack validated by security (reviewed and approved), concierge credit purchase route in Console, signed export PDF generation working for concierge-prepared attestations, dashboard with conversion and turnaround metrics.

Rollout plan: 1) internal alpha with SRE/Legal (2 weeks) 2) invite-only pilot with 6 customers (4 weeks) 3) evaluate and iterate, expand to self-serve if metrics hit targets.

updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff with Sales Ops, Legal, and Security. Agreed scope: pilot limited to mid-market customers in NA. Action: Security to review CAIQ snippets by 2025-02-21 (owner: Marco Ruiz).
2025-02-20: Security provided first-pass edits to CAIQ template; shorthand answers for non-applicable items approved. See doc: https://drive.google.com/file/d/CAIQ-template-v1
2025-02-25: Finance confirmed billing hook feasibility for 'concierge credits' via existing usage metering. Need a small billing PR to map SKU. Owner: Jenna Park. Ticket created: FIN-8812.

2025-02-27: UX review completed. Feedback: clarify refund policy and SLA for concierge purchases; add explicit signed-delivery window. Figma comments: https://www.figma.com/file/OnrampMockups#comments

2025-03-03: Built initial pilot dashboard in Metabase (query: attestation.turnaround_by_customer). Preliminary baseline observed: median turnaround 21 days over last 12 months. Dash board link: https://metabase.redwood/board/attestation-onramp

2025-03-05: Legal requested versioned audit trail for all attestations. Engineering estimates 3 sprint work for export + audit-log integration. Decision: include minimal audit fields in pilot (submitter, timestamp, version) and schedule full audit integration for release-2. Owner: Anika Chen (Engineering).
notes: Trade-offs discussed: deeper automation of CAIQ answers reduces time but may increase risk of inaccuracies; agreed to include a 'confidence indicator' and require manual confirm for fields marked low-confidence.
Risk: concierge model could create expectation of free SE time. Mitigation: explicit paid credit model + sales playbook and quote templates clarifying scope.
Feedback loop: capture reasons customers pick concierge credits in a short survey post-delivery to refine pricing and SLAs.
Related: coordinate with runtime-1.18 release team for any console SDK changes required by 2025-04 rollout.
